scope: Queue execution boundary and stationary proposal validation
reviewedCallChain: DrivingQueueAgreementServer -> owner VERIFY -> server ACK -> owner RESULT AGREED
DrivingQueueAgreementRelease and original-expiry closures retire consent only
Explicit root COMMIT -> broker -> owner COMMIT -> private armed consent
DrivingAssistStart -> DrivingQueueHold OBSERVE -> sole cap write -> APPLIED -> later sampled READY
Participant READY -> broker current all-motion check -> passive holdReady record; no reverse executor
implemented: Proposal and every deferred current-context validation now require finite angular speed below0.01rad/s in addition to total linear speed below1km/h.
No new messages, speed writer, actor/native movement command, scheduler or automatic queue activation.
Explicit root-owner COMMIT authenticated against exact AGREED token/context/original expiry; at most initial delivery plus one retry.
Authenticated owner COMMIT arms private consent without movement commands or new expiry timers.
DrivingQueueHold OBSERVE/APPLIED feeds the existing sole speed writer; exact token/brain/cap proof plus sampled1s linear<0.1m/s and angular<0.01rad/s permits one owner READY report.
Server authenticates the participant and checks current motion for all participants before setting aggregate readiness; readiness remains an observation, never a reverse grant.
Metadata publishes before READY delivery; cap takeover after application closes exact consent instead of reacquisition. Existing consent expiry and driving cap cleanup remain in charge.
executionPlan: Explicit root-owner COMMIT must bind the exact agreed token/serial/context and original expiry; authenticate it server-side before commanding owners.
Owners may arm only their own current driving brain and contribute a hold through the existing sole speed writer, retaining native command and cap provenance.
READY requires exact applied hold proof plus independently observed total linear and angular stillness over a bounded dwell; receipt presence is insufficient.
Only the dependency leaf may acquire a native reverse leg after all required participants are physically ready. Parent movement requires fresh full-hull room, not leaf acknowledgement.
Release/expiry/new native order/locality change must retire exact hold requests and restore only owned caps. Do not replay a command or replenish expiry.
Automatic proposal callers remain inactive until the entire execution/handback path exists.
remaining: Dependency-leaf reverse, phase-specific native receipts and independently measured full-hull room before parent movement remain unimplemented.
Explicit commit can safely refuse if an owner has not yet received matching AGREED; it never borrows PENDING. Actual delivery/retry order requires runtime validation.
READY does not start movement and is not an ongoing motion lease; any future executor must revalidate native context, holds and physical room.
Actual holds, stillness dwell, cancelled/expired restoration, normal/HC/JIP and measured overhead remain unverified.

validation.interimDisposition: Passed but superseded by corrected source/guide scope and aggregate current-motion readiness check; final exact artifact independently verified.

originalFinding: Current server protocol has BEGIN/ACK/RELEASE; owner protocol has VERIFY/RESULT. There is no COMMIT, speed hold, settled READY or native queue leg. AGREED must not be repurposed as physical movement authority.
cost: No new movement scheduler, world query, ray or recurring timer. OBSERVE uses at most4 canonical participants twice per cap sample; APPLIED uses cap metadata. Server READY adds at most4 current motion checks. Native metadata cost remains unmeasured.
